news.title: PGA Division 1 report: Chelsea Women Under-18s 10-2 Birmingham City
news.title_zh: PGA Division 1 报告：切尔西 18 岁以下女子队 10-2 伯明翰城
news.body_en: Chelsea Women’s Under-18s, who play in Division 1 of the PGA Women’s Under-21 League, produced a dominant display at Kingsmeadow on Sunday, scoring ten goals against Birmingham City. Despite conceding inside the opening minute, the Blues responded impressively, netting three times shortly before the break and then adding seven more goals after the interval. Seven different Chelsea players got on the scoresheet, with the result extending our unbeaten start to the Division 1 campaign. The performance also featured contributions from several members of our Under-16s squad. The visitors made a dream start, scoring just 22 seconds after kick-off. A misplaced pass allowed Birmingham to move forward quickly and, after working the ball into the penalty area, they found the net from close range. Chelsea responded positively and began to establish control of possession, with our pressure rewarded in the 38th minute. Keira Johnson set the ball back for Tess Finn, who drove beyond the Birmingham defence before finishing from inside the penalty area to equalise. Four minutes later, the Blues went ahead. Nelly Las and Johnson combined on the right before the latter's cross was cut out. The clearance fell to Maria Mayers on the edge of the area, and she took a touch before firing into the top-left corner and celebrating in style (top). There was still time for another before the break. Straight from kick-off, Las played the ball forward to Ella Abayomi, whose pass across the edge of the penalty area found Gabi Storey. The defender struck first time, sending an excellent effort beyond the goalkeeper to make it 3-1. Chelsea maintained their attacking momentum in the second half, with Abayomi adding her name to the scoresheet five minutes after the restart. Las delivered from the right and Abayomi finished confidently inside the penalty area. Jahmya Putman made it five in the 61st minute. Chloe Sarwie released Aysia Matabaro down the left, and the winger reached the byline before cutting the ball back for Putman to finish first time. A Birmingham defender then turned Sarwie's inswinging corner into her own net in the 66th minute, before Abayomi scored her second two minutes later. Matabaro again provided the delivery, picking out the forward inside the box for a composed finish. Storey then claimed her second of the afternoon in the 75th minute, meeting Las's pass with a shot that flew past the goalkeeper. Birmingham pulled one back a minute later after a long clearance caused problems for the Chelsea defence, allowing their striker to run through and score. The Blues responded with two more goals. Matabaro drove through the penalty area before finishing with her right foot in the 79th minute, following Maria Mayers' pass. The scoring was completed in the 88th minute. Mayers regained possession and found Matabaro on the left, whose cross reached Las. She controlled before shooting, with a deflection helping the ball find the top corner to complete the 10-goal haul. The victory means Chelsea remain unbeaten in PGA Division 1 after four matches, collecting ten points from a possible 12 as we head into the international break. The Blues now take a break from domestic action, with several members of the squad set to represent their countries at Under-17 and Under-19 level. Chelsea return to PGA Division 1 action on Wednesday 9 December, when we travel to face Bristol City. Chelsea (3-4-3): Victoria Rudz (Bella Bartlett 63); Zoe Ciccardini (Annie Boichat 45), Gabi Storey, Sadie Gregory; Maria Mayers, Tess Finn, Keira Johnson (Ella Abayomi 45), Rebekah Pierce (Chloe Sarwie 45); Nelly Las, Carla Gardiner (Jahmya Putman 45), Aysia MatabaroScorers: Finn 38, Mayers 42, Storey 45, 75, Abayomi 50, 68, Putman 61, Own goal 66, Matabaro 79, Las 88Booked: Boichat 90
news.body_zh: 切尔西 18 岁以下女子队参加 PGA 21 岁以下女子联赛第 1 级，周日在 Kingsmeadow 对阵伯明翰城的比赛中打进 10 粒进球，展现出统治力。尽管开场一分钟就丢球，但蓝军的反应令人印象深刻，在中场休息前不久就攻入三球，并在中场休息后又进了七个球。七名不同的切尔西球员取得了进球，这使得我们在一级联赛中保持不败开局。这场表演还得到了我们 16 岁以下球队的几位成员的贡献。客队取得了梦幻般的开局，开球仅22秒就进球了。一次失误的传球让伯明翰迅速向前推进，将球送入禁区后，他们近距离射门破门。切尔西积极回应并开始控制控球，我们的压力在第 38 分钟得到了回报。凯拉·约翰逊将球回传给泰斯·芬恩，泰斯·芬恩突破了伯明翰的防守，然后在禁区内射门扳平比分。四分钟后，蓝军取得领先。内莉·拉斯和约翰逊在右路联手，后者的传中被切出。解围落在禁区边缘的玛丽亚·梅耶斯手中，她触球后射入左上角，并以时尚的方式庆祝（上图）。中场休息前还有时间再做一次。开球后，拉斯将球传给埃拉·阿巴约米，后者在禁区边缘的传球找到了加比·斯托里。后卫第一时间射门，一脚出色的射门越过门将，将比分改写为3-1。下半场切尔西继续保持进攻势头，开场五分钟后阿巴约米就进球了。拉斯右路传球，阿巴约米在禁区内自信射门。贾米亚·普特曼在第 61 分钟打进五球。克洛伊·萨尔维(Chloe Sarwie)在左路释放了艾西亚·马塔巴罗(Aysia Matabaro)，这位边锋到达边线，然后将球回切，普特曼首次完成射门。第66分钟，一名伯明翰后卫将萨尔维的内旋角球打入自家球门，两分钟后阿巴约米攻入第二个进球。马塔巴罗再次提供传球机会，他在禁区内挑选了前锋，完成了冷静的射门。随后，斯托里在第 75 分钟完成了下午的第二个进球，接应拉斯的传球，一脚射门飞过门将。一分钟后，伯明翰队扳回一球，因为长时间的解围给切尔西队的防线带来了麻烦，让他们的前锋跑了过去得分。蓝军又进了两个球作为回应。第79分钟，马塔巴罗突破禁区，接玛丽亚·迈耶斯传球，右脚射门。第88分钟，进球完成。迈耶斯重新夺回控球权，并在左侧找到了马塔巴罗，后者的传中传到了拉斯。她在射门前控制住了球，并通过一个偏转帮助球飞上顶角，完成了 10 球的进球。这场胜利意味着切尔西在四场比赛后在 PGA 一级联赛中保持不败，在国际比赛日到来之际，在可能的 12 分中积攒了 10 分。蓝军现在暂时停止国内比赛，球队的几名成员将代表自己的国家参加U-17和U-19级别的比赛。切尔西将于 12 月 9 日星期三重返 PGA Division 1 比赛，届时我们将迎战布里斯托尔城。切尔西（3-4-3）：维多利亚·鲁兹（贝拉·巴特利特 63）； Zoe Ciccardini（Annie Boichat 45）、Gabi Storey、Sadie Gregory；玛丽亚·梅耶斯、泰丝·芬恩、凯拉·约翰逊 (Ella Abayomi 45)、丽贝卡·皮尔斯 (Chloe Sarwie 45)；内莉·拉斯 (Nelly Las)、卡拉·加德纳 (Jahm​​ya Putman 45)、艾西亚·马塔巴罗 (Aysia Matabaro) 进球数：芬恩 38、迈耶斯 42、斯托里 45、75、阿巴约米 50、68、普特曼 61、乌龙球 66、马塔巴罗 79、拉斯 88 黄牌：博伊查 90

news.title: Chelsea Diary: Away days and Academy derby on the agenda

news.body_en: Here is everything to look out for at Chelsea this week, including two away fixtures on Friday night and another London derby for our Under-18s. As well as providing reaction to the games against Leeds and Liverpool for our men’s and women’s teams respectively, we will be rounding up which of Sonia Bompastor’s squad are away on international duty. Qualifying for next summer’s World Cup in Brazil reaches its conclusion over the next fortnight, with several Blues still hoping to book their place at the tournament. Attention turns towards the challenge facing our men's first team, with preparations continuing at Cobham ahead of Friday night's Premier League trip to Nottingham Forest. We will bring you the latest from the training ground throughout the week, including behind-the-scenes footage. We will carry an exclusive interview with Emmanuel Emegha, who marked his full debut for the Blues by scoring a superb goal against Leeds United. Xabi Alonso will be conducting his usual pre-match press conference at Cobham the day before our next fixture. You will be able to see Alonso speak to the media live on the Chelsea Official App and website, with the manager giving his thoughts on the Nottingham Forest fixture and providing the latest injury news. There are two away fixtures to look forward to on Friday evening. First up, Cobham Next Gen are in Premier League 2 as they travel to face Norwich City at the Avant Training Centre. The young Blues return to league action at 7pm, and CFC+ subscribers can watch the game live in our Norwich City vs Chelsea Cobham Next Gen Match Centre. Alonso’s side then have the slightly later kick-off of 8pm at the City Ground. The match will be broadcast live on Sky Sports in the UK, while supporters can follow all the build-up, confirmed team news, minute-by-minute updates and live commentary in our Nottingham Forest vs Chelsea Match Centre. We will also bring you highlights and reaction from Alonso and his players following the final whistle. Chelsea Under-18s make the trip across London to face Crystal Palace at the Eagles’ training ground, with kick-off at 11am. Blues supporters will be able to watch that game live on the Chelsea Official App and website, with highlights to follow later in the day. You’ll also have the opportunity to watch the Nottingham Forest game back in full, with further reaction to how the contest in the East Midlands unfolded. We will finish the week by summarising how the Chelsea Women players involved in international duty this week have fared, with action in Asia, North America and South America.

news.title: Bompastor: Lola Brown’s mentality is ‘unbelievable’
news.title_zh: Bompastor：洛拉·布朗的心态“令人难以置信”
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor was full of praise for Lola Brown after her impressive Chelsea cameo in our Women’s Super League draw with Liverpool. The 19-year-old came off the bench and had a big impact on the left flank, causing trouble for the hosts and creating a chance for Sjoeke Nusken that forced a fantastic save from Khiara Keating in the Liverpool goal. Bompastor said that while competition for places is currently high, Brown’s mentality has been ‘unbelievable’ as she looks to earn more time on the pitch. ‘Lola didn't get many minutes [previously],’ Bompastor said. ‘The competition is high in this squad with many experienced players. ‘What she's been doing since the summer has been good, really good. Her mentality is unbelievable; she always works hard and puts a big effort on the pitch. ‘The quality she brings with the ball, she's a really confident player. I just felt from what I could observe in this game, she was probably the right profile to come on as the left wing-back. ‘I think we wanted to create more with crosses. She did well, we couldn't convert some of the crosses that she put in the box, but again from everyone I had available on the bench, she was probably the right profile to replace Sandy Baltimore.’ Brown has been called up to England Women’s Under-23s squad for the forthcoming international break, with matches against Belgium and Portugal on the agenda.
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特 (Sonia Bompastor) 在女足超级联赛战平利物浦的切尔西客场表现令人印象深刻后，对洛拉·布朗 (Lola Brown) 赞不绝口。这位19岁的球员替补出场，在左翼产生了巨大的影响，给主队带来了麻烦，并为舍克·努斯肯创造了机会，迫使基亚拉·基廷在利物浦的球门中做出了精彩的扑救。邦帕斯特表示，虽然目前位置竞争激烈，但布朗的心态“令人难以置信”，因为她希望在球场上赢得更多时间。 “洛拉（之前）没有得到太多上场时间，”邦帕斯特说。 “这支球队的竞争非常激烈，有很多经验丰富的球员。 “自夏天以来她所做的一切都很好，非常好。她的心态令人难以置信；她总是努力工作，在球场上付出巨大的努力。 “她的球技非常出色，她是一位非常自信的球员。从我在这场比赛中观察到的情况来看，我觉得她可能是担任左翼后卫的合适人选。 “我认为我们想用十字架创造更多。她表现很好，我们无法将她在禁区内的一些传中转化为球，但从我替补席上所有可用的人来看，她可能是取代桑迪·巴尔的摩的合适人选。布朗已被征召入英格兰女子23岁以下国家队阵容，参加即将到来的国际比赛日，对阵比利时和葡萄牙的比赛也已列入议程。

news.title: Romeo Lavia: This is not the moment to panic
news.title_zh: 罗密欧·拉维亚：现在不是惊慌的时刻
news.body_en: Romeo Lavia says Chelsea must use the pain of yesterday's 4-1 defeat to Leeds United as fuel to provoke a strong reaction, starting with our trip to Nottingham Forest next week. The Blues started brightly at Stamford Bridge and deservedly took the lead midway through the first half when Emmanuel Emegha marked his full debut with a clinical left-footed finish. However, Noah Okafor levelled just three minutes later, and after Dominic Calvert-Lewin converted from the penalty spot early in the second half, further strikes from Okafor and Brenden Aaronson condemned us to a heavy home defeat. Lavia did not hide his frustration at letting a promising start slip away, though he was clear that the dressing room will remain calm and united. ‘Everyone is very angry and disappointed,’ said Lavia. ‘At home this is never the way you want to finish a game. We let them back in the game when we shouldn’t have. This is something we will analyse and get better at. ‘When we won games, when we lost games, we always said that no matter what, it’s a process,’ Lavia added. ‘With these types of results, it feels like the end of the world, but we are not going to ring the bell now to say it’s a panic moment. Not at all. We are very confident as a team. We know where we want to get to. ‘This hurts, it needs to hurt so it provokes a reaction from the team, and this is definitely going to help us for the next game on Friday.’ Lavia also acknowledged the disappointment felt by supporters inside Stamford Bridge. The Belgian emphasised that the players take full accountability for falling short of the standards expected. ‘Of course, this is Chelsea Football Club, a club that wins trophies and is expected at the highest level every time,’ Lavia said. ‘At home it hurts times ten. You always want to give the fans what they deserve, and that wasn’t the case. We understand it and we take full responsibility.’
news.body_zh: 罗密欧·拉维亚表示，切尔西必须利用昨天1-4输给利兹联的痛苦作为燃料，从下周前往诺丁汉森林开始，引发强烈反应。蓝军在斯坦福桥开局出色，上半场中段当之无愧地取得领先，伊曼纽尔·埃梅加以一脚冷静的左脚射门完成了他的全面首秀。然而，诺亚·奥卡福仅仅三分钟后就扳平了比分，下半场早些时候多米尼克·卡尔弗特-勒温从点球点射门后，奥卡福和布伦登·阿伦森的进一步进球使我们在主场惨败。拉维亚并没有掩饰他对让一个充满希望的开局溜走的沮丧，尽管他很清楚更衣室将保持平静和团结。 “每个人都非常愤怒和失望，”拉维亚说。 “在主场，这绝不是你想要的结束比赛的方式。当我们不应该让他们回到比赛时，我们却让他们回到了比赛中。这是我们将分析并做得更好的事情。 “当我们赢得比赛时，当我们输掉比赛时，我们总是说，无论如何，这都是一个过程，”拉维亚补充道。 “有了这些类型的结果，感觉就像世界末日一样，但我们现在不会敲响警钟说这是一个恐慌时刻。”一点也不。作为一个团队，我们非常有信心。我们知道我们想去哪里。 “这很伤人，它需要受伤，所以它会引起球队的反应，这肯定会对我们周五的下一场比赛有所帮助。”拉维亚也承认斯坦福桥内的支持者感到失望。比利时人强调，球员们对未达到预期标准承担全部责任。 “当然，这是切尔西足球俱乐部，一家赢得奖杯的俱乐部，每次都被期望达到最高水平，”拉维亚说。 ‘在家里疼十倍。你总是想给球迷他们应得的东西，但事实并非如此。我们理解这一点，并承担全部责任。

news.title: Keeper voted Star of the Match in Liverpool stalemate

news.body_en: Hannah Hampton has been voted the Chelsea Women Star of the Match in our goalless draw with Liverpool. In a closely contested encounter where neither side could find a breakthrough, it was our goalkeeper who stood out most to supporters who gave their verdict in our poll on the Chelsea Official App. Hampton earned 45 per cent of the vote to claim the accolade. The keeper made a couple of important first-half saves to keep the game goalless, and her calm distribution was a key part of our build-up play. Youngster Lola Brown finished second in the poll with 24 per cent after an energetic and fearless performance after coming off the bench, while Ellie Carpenter was third with 17 per cent of the vote following a typically tireless display with contributions at both ends.

news.title: Alonso: We need to be tougher to recover from setbacks
news.title_zh: 阿隆索：我们需要更加坚强才能从挫折中恢复过来
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has identified the key area his Chelsea team needs to improve as he reflects on a disappointing afternoon at Stamford Bridge on Saturday, believing we have to learn to take a 'punch' and bounce back stronger. Despite taking the lead against Leeds United through Emmanuel Emegha’s first goal for the club, the Blues never recovered after the visitors responded with a quick equaliser, as three second-half goals condemned us to a 4-1 defeat in the Premier League. Our manager admitted it was a particularly tough result to take given the rivalry between the two clubs, as he shared the supporters’ frustration at the final whistle. ‘I understand their disappointment for sure, and we share that with them,’ he said. ‘The only thing we can do is work, try to give our best to turn it back and to do much better. ‘We were disappointed, the fans were disappointed. We were disappointed because the expectations from them are high and we feel sorry for them. We need to go through this together and to find solutions together. ‘Now, for sure, it's not the easiest moment. We're in a fragile moment, but we need to work together and stick together, because there’s still such a long way to go.’ In order to find those solutions, Alonso wants his team to be more resilient to bounce back from on-pitch setbacks, an area he feels we lacked both in Saturday’s game and the loss away at Sunderland before the international break. That is along with better handling opponents like those, who take a physical and direct approach to the game, especially given it is something he expects us to face on a regular basis in the Premier League. ‘We need to find solutions for sure, because there will be setbacks during any game, and we have to be tougher and to be able to go through that and to know that there’s still so long to play. It's something mandatory in this competition. ‘I felt that probably we are in a fragile moment mentally, in our confidence. When we received a punch we didn't recover from that strong or tough enough. That was my feeling. ‘We need to deal with that because this is the demand of the Premier League. Not just yesterday. When we go on Friday against Forest, this will happen to them. There were moments that we were not competing at the level required. We need to know that's mandatory in this competition, because we will face teams with that demand again. ‘But the physicality, the duels, that is not the only explanation. We could do better in a football way – not giving the ball away, trying to progress a little bit more, choosing better options. But as well, the physicality and the mentality are parts we can do better. ‘Our job is to try to find solutions, to work on that, to have experiences – bad experiences like yesterday, and hopefully we will have good ones when we can – and overcome even during the game a difficult moment, because this is football and for sure that will happen. In the progression, in the process that I often talk about, this is a very important topic.’ Alonso now has just under a week to work with his team at Cobham to try to rectify those issues before our next fixture, when we travel to Nottingham Forest for the Premier League’s Friday evening kick-off.
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索在回顾周六斯坦福桥令人失望的下午时，已经确定了他的切尔西队需要改进的关键领域，他相信我们必须学会承受“打击”并以更强的方式反弹。尽管凭借埃马纽埃尔·埃梅加的俱乐部首个进球在对阵利兹联的比赛中取得领先，但在客队快速扳平比分后，蓝军再也没有恢复元气，下半场的三个进球让我们在英超联赛中以 4-1 落败。我们的主教练承认，考虑到两家具乐部之间的竞争，这是一个特别艰难的结果，因为他和球迷们一样对终场哨声感到沮丧。他说：“我当然理解他们的失望，我们也与他们分享这一点。” “我们唯一能做的就是工作，尽力扭转局面，做得更好。” “我们很失望，球迷也很失望。我们很失望，因为他们的期望很高，我们为他们感到难过。我们需要共同经历这个过程并共同寻找解决方案。 “现在，可以肯定的是，这不是最容易的时刻。我们正处于一个脆弱的时刻，但我们需要共同努力，团结一致，因为还有很长的路要走。”为了找到这些解决方案，阿隆索希望他的球队能够更有弹性地从球场上的挫折中恢复过来，他认为我们在周六的比赛和国际比赛日之前客场输给桑德兰的比赛中都缺乏这一点。与此同时，我们还能更好地处理像那些在比赛中采取身体对抗和直接进攻的对手，特别是考虑到他希望我们在英超联赛中经常面对这样的对手。 “我们肯定需要找到解决方案，因为任何比赛都会遇到挫折，我们必须更加坚强，能够度过难关，并且知道比赛还有很长的路要走。”这是本次比赛中必须要做的事情。 “我觉得我们的精神和信心可能正处于脆弱的时刻。当我们受到打击时，我们没有从足够强大或坚韧的状态中恢复过来。这就是我的感觉。 “我们需要解决这个问题，因为这是英超联赛的要求。不只是昨天。当我们周五对阵森林队时，这种情况就会发生在他们身上。有些时候我们没有达到所需的水平。我们需要知道这在本次比赛中是强制性的，因为我们将再次面对有这种要求的球队。 “但是肉体、决斗并不是唯一的解释。我们可以以足球的方式做得更好——不放弃球权，努力进步一点，选择更好的选择。但同样，身体和心态也是我们可以做得更好的部分。 “我们的工作是努力寻找解决方案，努力解决这个问题，积累经验——像昨天一样的糟糕经历，希望我们能有好的经验——甚至在比赛期间克服困难，因为这就是足球，这肯定会发生。”在我经常谈论的过程中，这是一个非常重要的话题。阿隆索现在只有不到一周的时间与他在科巴姆的团队合作，试图在我们前往诺丁汉森林参加周五晚上英超联赛开球之前纠正这些问题。

news.title: Bronze frustrated after dominant display against Liverpool
news.title_zh: 铜牌在对阵利物浦的比赛中表现出色后感到沮丧
news.body_en: Lucy Bronze admitted she and her Chelsea team-mates were frustrated after being unable to convert their dominance over Liverpool into a win in the Women’s Super League. The 0-0 draw on Saturday leaves the Blues two points clear at the top of the table, but Manchester City will be in action on Sunday with a chance to reclaim top spot before the international break. It was a performance full of control for Sonia Bompastor’s side, especially in the second half, but Liverpool keeper Khiara Keating was in inspired form, with a save from Sjoeke Nusken the pick of her numerous saves. After coming away with a point from St Helens Stadium, Bronze said the team have to score more goals from the chances they are creating, a theme that has troubled them at times already this year. ‘Yeah, [it was frustrating],’ Bronze said. ‘Especially after the second half. ‘First half was a bit more even, although we created some good chances, they had one or two as well, Hannah had some good saves - more than she usually has. ‘But then the second half, I think we completely dominated the game. It just felt like Nusken's chance at the end, probably on another day, that goes in the back of the net, and a few other chances as well. Obviously Khiara Keating had a great game.' Bronze acknowledged that Saturday's draw with Liverpool was reflective of several matches already this season and recognised the Blues expect more. She continued: 'The end product was there a few times, but the goalkeeper saved it. We need to create more, we need to do more, score more goals. 'I think that's been the story of our season - not scoring as many goals in certain games as we should do. Thinking of the draws we've had with Aston Villa and Everton. Same today. All games, again we should be winning and scoring more goals.’
news.body_zh: 露西·青铜承认，她和她的切尔西队友在无法将对利物浦的统治地位转化为女足超级联赛的胜利后感到沮丧。周六0-0战平后，蓝军在积分榜上以两分的优势领先，但曼城将在周日采取行动，有机会在国际比赛日之前重新夺回榜首位置。对于索尼娅·邦帕斯托的球队来说，这是一场充满控制力的表现，尤其是在下半场，但利物浦门将基亚拉·基廷状态出色，斯约克·努斯肯的扑救是她众多扑救中的一个。在从圣海伦斯体育场拿下一分后，布朗泽表示球队必须利用他们创造的机会取得更多进球，这个主题今年已经时常困扰着他们。 “是的，[这令人沮丧]，”布朗兹说。 “尤其是下半场之后。 “上半场比赛更加均衡，虽然我们创造了一些好机会，但他们也有一两次，汉娜有一些很好的扑救——比平时更多。 “但是下半场，我认为我们完全统治了比赛。感觉就像努斯肯在最后的机会，可能是在另一天，进入网后，还有其他一些机会。显然基亚拉·基廷（Khiara Keating）打了一场精彩的比赛。布朗承认周六与利物浦的平局反映了本赛季已经发生的几场比赛，并承认蓝军期待更多。她继续说道：“最终产品出现过几次，但门将将其扑出。我们需要创造更多，我们需要做得更多，进球更多。 “我认为这就是我们这个赛季的故事——在某些比赛中没有取得应有的进球数。想想我们与阿斯顿维拉和埃弗顿的平局。今天也一样。所有比赛，我们都应该再次获胜并进更多球。

news.title: Bompastor: We must be more clinical and find a better balance
news.title_zh: Bompastor：我们必须更加临床并找到更好的平衡
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor insists she is happy with the way her Chelsea side are performing, but says they must find a better balance between being solid defensively and creating more goals as they continue to challenge on multiple fronts. The Blues came out 1-0 winners against Paris Saint-Germain in the UEFA Women’s Champions League in midweek thanks to a late goal from Veerle Buurman. However, they were unable to find another strike to put Liverpool to the sword, despite an incredibly dominant second-half performance. Bompastor says that while her team needs to be more ruthless and clinical, the overall level of play has been impressive. ‘I think right now we need to find a better balance between the defensive aspects,’ Bompastor said in her press conference after the draw against Liverpool. ‘I'm really happy also with the way we build up no matter the opponent; if they come and man-mark, if they leave us a little bit more space. ‘The things we need to improve are in the creation-finishing phase: making sure we create as much as possible in the games and we are clinical and ruthless in the box when we have those opportunities.’ Bompastor said her side have been working on a number of aspects of their attacking play as they look to increase the number of goals scored, but added that sometimes these things do take time to come to fruition. ‘I think we were dominant in the second half,’ she added. ‘We have been working a lot on the final third, in the box, details around the timings of the runs, the positions in the box and the mentality around how we want to attack the box as well. ‘When I talk about being ruthless, clinical, it's the desire to be first on the ball. All these things we have been working on, and we will keep working on. ‘It takes a lot of time sometimes to get those connections right, and to be able to be in the right positions. But we need to keep working because sometimes the difference can be when you start to lose a little bit of confidence in that box, it can change things a little bit. ‘So we need to stay confident and make sure we do everything we can under our control to turn these things around. ‘I'm really happy with a lot of things we are doing right now. When you have ambitions, when you want to win titles, you need to make sure to find the right balance between being strong defensively but also being able to score goals. ‘So yeah, we need to be that team, and I would like to have a better balance in terms of being able to score more.’
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特坚称她对切尔西队的表现感到满意，但她表示，随着他们继续在多条战线上挑战，他们必须在稳固的防守和创造更多进球之间找到更好的平衡。周中的欧洲女子冠军联赛中，凭借维尔勒·布尔曼最后时刻的进球，蓝军以 1-0 战胜巴黎圣日耳曼队。然而，尽管下半场表现令人难以置信，但他们无法找到另一次进球来让利物浦陷入困境。邦帕斯特表示，虽然她的团队需要更加残酷和冷静，但整体比赛水平令人印象深刻。 “我认为现在我们需要在防守方面找到更好的平衡，”邦帕斯特在战平利物浦后的新闻发布会上说道。 “无论对手如何，我对我们的进攻方式也非常满意；如果他们过来盯防，如果他们给我们多一点空间。 “我们需要改进的事情是在创造完成阶段：确保我们在比赛中创造尽可能多的机会，当我们有这些机会时，我们在禁区内保持冷静和无情。”庞帕斯特表示，她的球队一直在进攻的多个方面进行努力，因为他们希望增加进球数，但他补充说，有时这些事情确实需要时间才能实现。 “我认为我们在下半场占据了主导地位，”她补充道。 “我们在禁区最后三分之一、跑动时机、禁区位置以及我们想要如何进攻禁区的心态等细节上做了很多工作。 “当我谈到冷酷、冷静时，我指的是想要率先行动的渴望。所有这些事情我们一直在努力，并将继续努力。 “有时需要花费很多时间才能建立正确的连接，并能够处于正确的位置。但我们需要继续努力，因为有时差异可能是当你开始对那个盒子失去一点信心时，它可能会改变一些事情。 “因此，我们需要保持信心，并确保我们尽一切努力来扭转局面。” “我对我们现在正在做的很多事情感到非常满意。当你有雄心壮志时，当你想赢得冠军时，你需要确保在强大的防守和进球能力之间找到适当的平衡。 “所以，是的，我们需要成为那样的球队，我希望在能够得分更多方面有更好的平衡。”
